meal.title: Loops: while and for in C
meal.objective: Write while and for loops to repeat actions

voice.script: What if you could tell the computer to count to ten on its own? A while loop repeats as long as a condition stays true. It checks the condition before each pass, so the body may never run if the condition is false at the start. Now see the code: The program first sets a counter to one, then while the counter is less than or equal to five it prints the counter and adds one. After that it uses a for loop that declares a new counter, checks it against five, prints it, and increments it automatically. Running this program prints the numbers twice. Imagine a circle that loops back to the start each time. Use while when you only need a condition, for when you have a clear start, end, and step. Write a while loop that sums numbers until the total exceeds 100.
